title: Наметить крупные реки и проверить их связи с крупными озёрами
problem: Existing hydrology has no verified WWN regional-step3 profile. Static RIV permits lake multiple outflows with inflow and does not expose ordinary channel1→2, so shared names do not prove profile equivalence.
benefit: An opt-in non-destructive regional hydrology plan/diagnostic can reuse directed networks and waterbody identities while exposing source-specific constraints and unknowns.

game_editions.edition: Worlds Without Number Deluxe, copyright2021; supplied Russian translation Lock-key; translation revision and English collation unverified

included: Opt-in regional-step3 draft, counts and typed connections
Existing RIV profile compatibility audit before implementation
Save/load and Undo/Redo of any future accepted plan/exception; existing map unchanged on invalid input
excluded: Override RIV rules or broaden active HX-BL-023 scope
Full WWN support, kingdom/local profiles, L2/L3
New implementation or publication in this run

dependencies: Owner approval of bounded product implementation scope
Analyst resolves draft river-identity/port mapping and translation/length unknowns
Reuse existing hydrology and editor; do not create game-specific engine clone
